title: Unit – 4 : Session – 4 : SLO – 2  |  Branch Instructions — Match the Following
sections: 1. JMP — D. Jump to address unconditionally.
2. BEQ — A. Branch if result is zero (zero flag set).
3. BNE — E. Branch if result is not zero.
4. BCS — C. Branch if carry flag is set.
5. JSR — B. Unconditional jump to subroutine (saves return address).
7. BPL — G. Branch if result is positive (sign flag clear).
8. BMI — H. Branch if result is negative (sign flag set).
9. BVC — I. Branch if overflow flag is clear.
10. BGE — J. Branch if greater than or equal (sign and overflow flags equal).
